integrity: Exact formula and Poisson/Gumbel proof are self-contained. A standalone standard-library finite-volume checker corroborates the identities; finite enumeration is not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Distributional n→infinity result for homogeneous length-two dimer attempts on an open finite path; no finite-n rate, other car sizes, or nonuniform attempt rates are proved. Relevant historical priority remains a literature-access risk.
title: Gumbel saturation and a Poisson rare-gap law for discrete dimer parking
